note: One entry per stored dataset or feature family. Clocks: t (event/window), r (request start), observed_at (collector write = first durable availability in this repository), t_ret (per-source retrieval inside a snapshot), t_event (source's own stamp where it gives one). Availability is never the event time (lab/data.py, research_tools/evidence_contract.py). Statements marked 'assumed' are not measured.

instruments.funding: 8h settlement at 00/08/16 UTC; premiumIndex.lastFundingRate is the live estimate, fundingRate rows are settled

instruments.contract: USD notional; open interest in USD (convert at mark)

costs.fees_note: Taker fees are account-tier dependent and are not observed by the collector; every simulated cost is an assumption stated by the protocol that uses it (PS1 protocol.json, O33 COST_BP). Funding conventions above.

datasets.cadence: 1-minute bars, written in batches each collector run (~15 min)
datasets.event_semantics: bar open time t; closes at t + 60 s
datasets.revision: a closed bar is not revised by the venue; the first stored copy wins
datasets.missingness: gaps are measured by report.py section 2; never filled
datasets.recoverability: public history refetchable (lab/data.fetch_history) as a RECONSTRUCTION with assumed availability

datasets.availability: max(batch observed_at, bar close); spot is retrieved after perp in each run (measured by research_tools/funnel.py)

datasets.source: collector market snapshot: Binance premiumIndex (USDT, USDC, COIN-M), depth (Binance USD-M, OKX swap; BTC within 25/50/100/200 bp), open interest across ~15 venues (oi_btc per venue, t_ret each), Hyperliquid predicted fundings (Binance, Bybit, Hyperliquid), premium parts (Coinbase BTC-USD, USDT-USD, Binance and OKX spot), Bitfinex margin, ETH/SOL cross-venue
datasets.cadence: one per collector run (schedule 7,22,37,52 * * * * plus recovery runs)
datasets.event_semantics: t = run start; each source carries t_ret and, where the venue gives one, t_event
datasets.availability: observed_at (the snapshot's write); per-source t_ret is retrieval, not availability
datasets.missingness: per-source st != ok is recorded with its error; never zero

units.depth: BTC within the stated bp of mid

datasets.recoverability: not recoverable: venue snapshot endpoints have no history

datasets.retention: API ~30 days; Git keeps what was collected

datasets.note: shares are composition, not contract counts (package R-02)

datasets.source: Deribit book summaries for every listed BTC option
datasets.fields_note: panel rows: instrument, t, bid/ask, mark_iv, open interest, greeks, underlying
datasets.note: maturity/moneyness definitions for a skew feature are not yet frozen (panel family options_disagreement is gated)

datasets.source: OKX public/liquidation-orders BTC-USDT-SWAP, paged each run
datasets.event_semantics: t = fill time; no order id
datasets.revision: same-key different-size records exist (645 of 31,507 keys, Oct 14): ambiguous unless one retrieval held both (package M-15)
datasets.retention: OKX live pager covers ~15 min; Git keeps captures
datasets.recoverability: not recoverable after the pager's window

datasets.source: Hyperliquid info API (clearinghouseState) for a fixed and a rotating cohort
datasets.constraints: public addresses; cohort selection rules in state/hl_cohort_fixed_v2.json

datasets.source: collector run records (trigger, critical_ok, errors, http, elapsed)
datasets.use: operational evidence; not a market input

datasets.source: stream/service.py WebSocket recorder: Deribit, Bybit, Hyperliquid books, trades, liquidations
datasets.availability: receive time per message; derived rows usable 5 s after t
datasets.status: implemented and tested; NOT commissioned (no persistent host authorised)

feature_families.formula: signed aggressive flow over the last 15 closed minutes, (2*tbv - v) in BTC, divided by Binance USD-M depth within 25 bp (bid+ask, BTC) from the latest snapshot available at the decision
feature_families.edge_cases: depth < 1 BTC or missing: insufficient-depth (no value)

feature_families.formula: 15-minute log return (bp) per 100 BTC of signed flow over the same completed window; only when |flow| >= 5 BTC
each venue's predicted rate normalized to 8h (rate x 8 / interval_h); dispersion = max - min across Binance, Bybit, Hyperliquid; level = mean
1h OI change (%) from 5-minute OI history available at the decision; 1h log return (bp); their product; OI change per 1h traded volume (BTC/BTC)
(perp mark / spot - 1) in bp at the latest snapshot available
